## Projects

### Autonomous Learning — AI LMS

An AI-powered learning environment combining personalised education, autonomous learning workflows and voice-based assistance.

- Capabilities: AI-powered learning modules; Knowledge retrieval; Personalised content generation; Multi-agent orchestration; Learner progress tracking; Assessment and verification agents; Interactive workspace; Voice-based learning assistance
- Technology: LangGraph, LangChain, Python, FastAPI, AWS, Amazon Bedrock, PostgreSQL, S3, LiveKit, LLMs
- Context: Built within an organisation as part of a product team.

### HireAI

An AI-powered recruitment and hiring platform where candidates move through an intelligent, automated hiring pipeline.

- Capabilities: AI-based candidate evaluation; Candidate and recruiter workflows; AI Fit Score; Recruitment automation; Assessment workflows; GitHub and technical profile integrations; Interview-related automation
- Context: Built within an organisation as part of a product team.

### Policyora — Knowledge Networks

An intelligent knowledge and policy research platform that turns large document collections into answerable, connected knowledge.

- Capabilities: Document intelligence; Knowledge retrieval; RAG architecture; AI-powered question answering; Knowledge processing; Enterprise information discovery
- Technology: RAG, LLMs
- Context: Built within an organisation as part of a product team.

### Voice AI — Orion Educational Society

An educational voice AI solution providing conversational, real-time, voice-based guidance and assistance.

- Capabilities: Conversational voice interaction; Speech-to-text; Text-to-speech; Voice-based guidance; Real-time communication; AI-powered assistance
- Technology: STT, TTS, LLMs
- Context: Delivered for an educational institution as part of a team.

### CRM Voice Agents

An AI voice automation solution connecting inbound and outbound voice agents, telephony infrastructure and CRM systems.

- Capabilities: Inbound and outbound voice agents; Lead qualification; Conversational automation; SIP telephony integrations; Speech processing; CRM integration; Call workflows
- Technology: LiveKit, ElevenLabs, SIP, STT, TTS, LLMs
- Context: Built within an organisation as part of a product team.
